mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog (blog_name, owner_user_id, is_public) VALUES (#{blogName}, #{ownerUserId}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog ORDER BY blog_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.*, COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count FROM blog b LEFT JOIN blog_member m ON b.blog_id = m.blog_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE b.is_public = 1 GROUP BY b.blog_id ORDER BY b.blog_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog WHERE is_public = 1
